comment: SPEC §31.12 eval fixtures. Generated once by the scripts in scripts/gen-pdf-fixtures/ (pinned Docker images; provenance recorded per fixture). expect classifies the document of record: text = all 3 phrases must be found after NFKC + lowercase + -\n join + whitespace collapse; no-text = the honest empty outcome; encrypted = the errPDFEncrypted hint. The encrypted password is fixture data, not a secret.

phrases: every note as a plain text file
runs once per day and never edits
turns web pages into fixed layout documents
the same font metrics on every run
test text extraction from browser output
efficient parser reads the whole file
each document either passes or fails
footnotes, sections, and math to stress

fixtures.producer: qpdf 12.2.0 (Debian trixie qpdf package inside Docker image debian:trixie-slim; no maintained standalone qpdf image exists)
fixtures.command: scripts/gen-pdf-fixtures/gen-encrypted.sh: qpdf --encrypt pkms-user-pw pkms-owner-pw 128 --use-aes=y -- /out/word-export.pdf /out/encrypted.pdf (128-bit AES V=4/R=4, not 256-bit: the incumbent rejects V=5/R=6 as unsupported instead of returning ErrInvalidPassword, which would dodge the errPDFEncrypted hint path this class asserts)
